subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add an admin contact inventory for WhatsApp pairing and allowlists, and what sender-ID redaction, account scope, permission fields, and last-active source should it expose?
rationale: The source gap is real, but listing phone numbers or sender IDs with permission and activity state changes a security-sensitive admin surface and overlaps `/allowlist`, `directory`, `channels status`, and the narrower approved-pairing request.

options.title: Define scoped admin inventory
options.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges approved pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and account-scope rules.

options.title: Narrow to pairing management first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56621 for approved-pairing list/revoke and defer group-policy and last-active columns until privacy and storage semantics are decided.

options.title: Defer to broader UI/admin design
options.body: Keep terminal surfaces as-is and require a broader Control UI or admin model before adding another permission-management command.

recommendation.title: Define scoped admin inventory
recommendation.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges approved pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and account-scope rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The overlapping `/allowlist`, pairing CLI, and allowFrom store history makes this the strongest available product/security-boundary routing candidate.
